name: Rhythm Knight 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Rhythm Knight is a 2D dungeon rogue-lite game where you can embark on a perilous journey as a knight who is tasked with uncovering the mystery of a cursed dungeon. Progress through the dungeon and unlock new weapons and spells to defeat a huge variety of enemies and challenging bosses.
